xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1.The audited consolidated financial results for the qtr and year ended 31-03-2025 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 20-05- 2025.
2.The statutory auditors of Bansal Wire Industries Limited (Parent company) have expressed an unmodified opinion on the audited consolidated financial results for the qtr and year ended 31.03.2025
3. Audited consol financial results of the Co. have been prepared as per Ind AS notified under Sec. 133 of the Co. Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Ind AS) Rules, 2015 (as amended) and in pursuant to guidelines issued under Reg. 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015, as amended.
4.The Co. has 2 subsidiaries - Bansal Steel & Power Limited (BSPL) and BWI Steel Pvt Limited (BWI). BSPL has become WOS of the Co. w.e.f. 31-07-2024 & BWI has been incorporated as a WOS on 04-10-2024 vide BR dated 03-09-2024(No operational activities started till date).
5.The subsidiary, BSPL is engaged in the business comprising two segments, manufacturing of Steel Wire products & job-work activities related to manufacturing of Steel Wire products. However, the job-work activities have been performed by the BSPL for the parent Co. only, therefore, at the group level there is no reportable revenue for the segment related to job-work activities, therefore, segment reporting as per Ind AS – 108 has not been made.
6.The equity shares of the Parent Co. have been listed on NSE & on BSE Limited on 10-07-2024 by IPO of 29101562 equity shares of face value of Rs.5 each at an issue price of Rs.256 per equity share (including share premium of Rs.251 per equity share) aggregating to Rs.7450 Mn. The equity shares were allotted to eligible shareholders vide BR dated 08-07-2024.
As of 31-03-2025, the utilization of IPO Proceeds is as follows:

i)Rs.4,526.83 Mn. has been fully utilized, allocated for the repayment or prepayment of certain outstanding borrowings of the Co.
ii)Rs. 937.08 Mn. has been fully utilized, allocated for investment in our Subsidiary to repay or prepay a portion of its outstanding borrowings.
iii)Rs. 600.00 Mn. has been fully utilized, allocated for funding the working capital requirements of our Co.
iv)Rs. 906.61 Mn. has been utilized out of Rs.906.62* Mn. allocated for general corporate purposes.
v)Rs. 478.80 Mn. has been paid out of Rs. 479.47* Mn. proposed for estimated issue expenses.
*The original estimated issue expenses were Rs. 520.57, however, the actual issue expenses being less than estimated as disclosed in the prospectus dated 05-07-2024 and therefore, the surplus issue expenses of Rs. 41.10 Mn. has been allocated towards General Corporate Purpose.

7.The figures for the qtr ended 31-03-2025 are the balancing figures between the audited figures for the year ended 31-03-2025 and reviewed published figures for the 9 months ended 31-12-2024. And the figures for the qtr ended 31-03-2024 are the balancing figures between the audited consol. figures for the year ended 31-03-2024 and the consolidated published figures for the 9 months ended 31-12-2023. The figures of BSPL have been consolidated w.e.f. 07-12-2023 only since it became subsidiary from 07-12-2023.
8.The consolidated audited financial results for the qtr and year ended 31-03-2025 are available on the Co.'s website at www.bansalwire.com and also on the website of BSE Limited at www.bseindia.com and NSE at www.nseindia.com, where the shares of the Co. are listed.
9.Figures for the periods/year are reclassified, regrouped wherever necessary to conform to current period presentation.
